initiatives.title: Financial goal-setting at onboarding (What are you saving for?)
initiatives.description: Add a goal-setting question at Step 1 of the Getting Started onboarding: 'What is your #1 financial goal right now?' with options like 'Build an emergency fund', 'Pay off debt', 'Save for a specific purchase', 'Grow net worth', 'Track daily spending'. The selected goal shapes the first commitment suggestion in Step 3 and personalises the first Fabric briefing. Stored in `profile.primaryGoal`. Zero engineering overhead — one field, enormous first-day personalisation.

initiatives.title: Spending freeze — category self-discipline pause mode
initiatives.description: A user can voluntarily 'freeze' a category (e.g., 'Eating Out') for a user-defined number of days. While frozen, attempting to create a transaction in that category shows a pause screen: 'You decided to pause this for 3 more days. Still record it?' This is awareness-only, not blocking. Stored as `categoryFreezes: Record<category, expiresAt>` in UserProfile. Empowers self-discipline without imposing rules.

initiatives.title: Monthly financial review flow — guided self-reflection
initiatives.description: On the first day of each month, Anchor prompts the user for a 2-minute guided financial review: (1) 'Your top 3 categories last month were X, Y, Z — how does that feel?' (2) 'You completed N/M commitments — what helped/hindered you?' (3) 'One thing to improve this month?' Answers stored as `monthlyReflections/{YYYY-MM}` subcollection. Fabric can surface patterns from these reflections. Turns the app into a behaviour change tool, not just a tracker.

initiatives.title: User-defined custom transaction categories
initiatives.description: Currently all 20+ categories are predefined (Groceries, Transport, etc.). Allow users to create custom category names with a chosen emoji and colour. Custom categories are stored under `profiles/{uid}/customCategories` and appear in the CategorySelector alongside built-in ones. Custom category data never shared with family by default. Solves a common support request and cultural gap (Nigerian context has categories not in the default list).

initiatives.title: Savings challenges (52-week, no-spend week, daily saving)
initiatives.description: A dedicated 'Challenges' section under Commitments. Pre-built challenge templates: 52-week savings challenge (₦100 week 1, ₦200 week 2...), no-spend week (no discretionary purchases 7 days), daily micro-saving (save ₦X every day). Challenge creates a linked savings account + automatic weekly commitment. Progress shown as fill bar. Non-gamified — no leaderboards, no badges. Just calm progress.

initiatives.title: Property-based testing for finance calculation utilities
initiatives.description: Add fast-check (property-based testing library) for `amountCents` arithmetic, balance reconciliation, and multi-currency conversion logic. Generate thousands of random inputs to find edge cases (negative amounts, billion-naira values, zero, MIN_SAFE_INTEGER). Currently unit tests cover known cases only. 5 test files: formatCurrency, TransactionService balance ops, TransferOperations exchange rate math, and AccountService balance update.

initiatives.title: E2E seed fixture system — deterministic Firestore state per scenario
initiatives.description: Create a `e2e/fixtures/seed.ts` system that writes deterministic Firestore emulator state before each E2E suite runs. Each suite declares `seed: 'finance-heavy-user' | 'new-user' | 'family-connected'`. Eliminates test interdependency, flakiness from shared test user state, and slow sign-up flows at E2E start. Currently all E2E tests share TEST_USER which creates race conditions when running in parallel.

initiatives.title: Stryker mutation score gate in CI merge-gate
initiatives.description: Stryker is configured (stryker.config.mjs) but its score is not enforced as a CI gate. Add a `mutation-test` job to .github/workflows/merge-gate.yml that runs Stryker on changed files only (incremental mode) and fails the build if the mutation score drops below 70 for finance and security modules. Currently mutation testing is ad hoc, not enforced. First gate: finance utils and Firestore rules.

initiatives.title: Cloud Function contract testing — callable I/O schema validation
initiatives.description: Add Zod schema validation for every callable Cloud Function input and output. Create `functions/src/schemas/` folder with Zod schemas matching the TypeScript interfaces. Tests validate that: (1) all required fields are enforced, (2) extra fields are stripped, (3) type coercion behaves correctly. Catches regressions where client sends a field the function no longer expects. Particularly critical for familyInvitations, shareAccount, and createRecurringTransaction.

initiatives.title: Privacy screen mode — blur sensitive balances on demand
initiatives.description: A persistent toggle (Settings → Privacy → 'Hide balances') that replaces all balance amounts and net worth figures with '****' across the entire app. Tap a blurred figure to temporarily reveal it for 3 seconds then re-blur. Protects against shoulder surfing in public. Implementation: CSS class `privacy-mode` on root + `blurSensitive` utility class on Amount components. State in `localStorage` so it persists across sessions.

initiatives.title: Auth event history — user-visible sign-in log with device and time
initiatives.description: Every successful sign-in writes a record to `users/{uid}/authEvents/{id}` with: `timestamp`, `deviceInfo` (user-agent parsed: OS, browser/app), `ipHash` (SHA-256 of IP, never raw IP stored). Settings → Security shows last 10 sign-in events. If a user sees an event they don't recognise, they can tap 'Not me' which triggers a forced sign-out of all sessions + email alert. Empowers users to self-detect account compromise.

initiatives.title: Terms of service and privacy policy version gate with re-acceptance
initiatives.description: Store current ToS and Privacy Policy version numbers in Remote Config (or a static constant). On each sign-in, check `profile.tosAcceptedVersion` against current version. If outdated, show a non-dismissable modal with the updated ToS/PP requiring acceptance before app access. Log acceptance event with version, timestamp, and user agent. Prevents users from disclaiming knowledge of policy updates. Critical for NDPR (Nigeria Data Protection Regulation) compliance.

initiatives.title: Home screen widgets — net worth and today's commitments
initiatives.description: Build iOS 14+ WidgetKit widget (via Capacitor plugin or native Swift bridging) and Android App Widget showing: (1) Small: Total net worth + change since yesterday. (2) Medium: Today's 3 commitments with completion toggles. Requires a separate Capacitor widget extension target. Data fetched from a lightweight Firestore endpoint keyed by uid stored in shared Keychain. High user retention impact — app visible even when not opened.

initiatives.title: App icon badge count for pending commitments
initiatives.description: Set the app icon badge to the number of incomplete commitments for today via Capacitor Badge plugin (`@capawesome/capacitor-badge`). Cleared when user opens app and marks commitments done. Updated via FCM data-only message when the reminder Cloud Function runs. Shows users at a glance that there are pending items without opening the app. High-engagement signal with zero in-app UI change needed.

initiatives.title: Share sheet — styled transaction or monthly recap as image card
initiatives.description: A 'Share' action on any transaction or monthly summary generates a styled PNG card (Anchor OS branded, no sensitive account names) using an off-screen Canvas render. On iOS/Android, this opens the native share sheet. The card design shows: category icon, amount (blurred if privacy mode), category, date, and Anchor OS watermark. Organic word-of-mouth marketing vector — shareable financial wins without exposing private data.

initiatives.title: Smart app store review prompt after positive milestone
initiatives.description: Trigger the native App Store / Google Play review prompt (Capacitor `@capacitor/rate-app`) after a user reaches a positive milestone: 7 consecutive days of commitment completions, net worth increases by 10%, or saves ₦10,000+ in a single month. Never prompt after an error or failed action. Never prompt more than once every 60 days. Prompt timing is proven to increase review rate by 3-5x vs cold prompts.

initiatives.title: Achievement share cards — branded milestone moments for social sharing
initiatives.description: When a user crosses a meaningful personal milestone (first ₦100k saved, 30-day commitment streak, debt cleared), Anchor shows a calm celebration screen with a shareable, beautifully designed card image. The card shows the milestone, the user's first name, and the Anchor OS logo. No account names, no balances. Tapping 'Share' opens the native share sheet (PLT-010). Turns personal wins into organic marketing impressions.

initiatives.title: In-app NPS survey after 30 days of active use
initiatives.description: 30 days after account creation (measured by `createdAt`), and only if the user has made ≥5 transactions and completed ≥3 commitments, show a one-question NPS survey: 'How likely are you to recommend Anchor to a friend or family member?' (0–10 scale). Detractors (0–6) see a feedback field. Results written to `analyticsEvents` collection for the data team. Never shown again after first response. Standard product health metric.

initiatives.title: Re-engagement email trigger for abandoned onboarding
initiatives.description: A Firestore trigger (or scheduled hourly function) detects users who completed Step 1 (name) but never reached Step 4 (security) within 48 hours. Triggers `sendTemplatedEmail()` with a personalised 're-engagement' template: 'You started setting up Anchor, your data is waiting for you.' Uses existing `sendTemplatedEmail` callable and existing email infrastructure. No SMS required. Recovers users who signed up but got distracted.

initiatives.title: What-if financial scenario modelling in Fabric
initiatives.description: Users can ask Fabric hypothetical questions: 'What if I reduced Food spending from ₦30k to ₦20k per month?' Fabric's PredictionsEngine runs a forward projection: projected savings over 3/6/12 months, estimated months-to-goal improvement, and impact on net worth trend. Displayed as a simple card with a before/after table. Purely client-side calculation from existing data — no LLM required. Huge engagement impact: turns passive tracking into active planning.

initiatives.title: Subscription pattern detection and auto-suggest recurring
initiatives.description: Fabric's BehavioralEngine analyses the last 3 months of manual transactions. When it detects ≥3 transactions to the same payee within ±3 days of recurring dates, at similar amounts (±10%), it surfaces a suggestion card: 'It looks like you pay ~₦1,500 to Netflix every month. Would you like to record this as a recurring expense?' One tap creates a recurring template. Works entirely on manual data — no bank needed. Reduces manual entry friction and improves budget forecast accuracy.

initiatives.title: Mood-finance correlation insights (spending behaviour vs emotional state)
initiatives.description: Fabric's mood check-in data (5-emoji daily mood log) exists but is not correlated with spending. InsightsEngine computes correlation between mood entries and discretionary spending (Food, Entertainment, Shopping categories) over a rolling 60-day window. Insight appears if correlation is statistically significant (Spearman ρ > 0.4): 'On days you log a difficult mood, your discretionary spending is 35% higher than your average.' Pure client-side calculation. Emotional intelligence layer on the data.

initiatives.title: Time-to-savings-goal projection — at your current rate, you'll reach X in Y months
initiatives.description: Once a user has defined a Savings Goal (PRD-002 / PRD-007), Fabric Predictions computes a forward projection: take the last 3-month average monthly surplus (income - expenses), extrapolate against the goal amount, and surface: 'At your current saving rate you'll reach your ₦500k goal in approximately 4 months.' Updated weekly. Shown as a progress arc on the Dashboard alongside the Productivity Widget. Simple yet extremely motivating — makes the goal feel real.

initiatives.title: Multi-turn conversation history in Fabric Query — persistent context
initiatives.description: Currently the Fabric free-text query input is stateless — each question is independent. Add persistence: conversation history stored in `users/{uid}/fabric/conversations/{date}` (max 20 messages per day, pruned). The QueryEngine receives the last 3 exchanges as context when parsing a new query, enabling follow-up questions like 'What about last month?' after 'How much did I spend on food?' A meaningful step toward conversational AI even before LLM integration (FAB-001).

initiatives.title: Shared TypeScript types package between src/ and functions/src/
initiatives.description: Currently `AnchorTransaction`, `AnchorAccount`, `UserProfile`, and all callable payload types are duplicated between `src/types/` and `functions/src/` with potential divergence. Create a `packages/types/` workspace package (`@anchor-os/types`) consumed by both `src/` and `functions/src/` via npm workspace. Single source of truth for all data model types. Eliminates an entire class of silent type drift bugs. Requires npm workspaces setup in root package.json.

initiatives.title: Optimistic undo — 30-second recovery window for delete operations
initiatives.description: For transaction delete and commitment delete, instead of permanent immediate removal: (1) Soft-delete with `isSoftDeleted: true` immediately (already supported in AnchorTransaction), (2) Show a bottom toast 'Transaction deleted — Undo (28s)' with countdown, (3) If user taps Undo, restore document by setting `isSoftDeleted: false`, (4) After 30s, a Cloud Function cleanup permanently removes soft-deleted documents. Uses existing `isSoftDeleted` field. Zero schema changes. Prevents 'I accidentally deleted 3 months of data' user distress.

initiatives.title: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing for Cloud Functions
initiatives.description: Instrument Cloud Functions with OpenTelemetry spans tracing the full request lifecycle: HTTP trigger → auth verification → Firestore write → response. Export to Google Cloud Trace (free in Firebase projects). Enables p95 latency tracking per callable, Firestore query timing, and cross-function trace correlation. Pairs with OBS-001 (SLO dashboard). Does not affect mobile bundle — server-side only. Critical for understanding where latency spikes occur in family invite and recurring transaction flows.

initiatives.title: PR preview deployments via Firebase Hosting preview channels
initiatives.description: Configure GitHub Actions to deploy each open PR to a Firebase Hosting preview channel: `npm run deploy:preview -- --channel=pr-{number}`. The workflow posts the preview URL as a PR comment. Reviewers can test on real Firebase infrastructure (including Auth, Firestore rules, Functions) without merging. Requires `firebase hosting:channel:deploy` in a new `preview.yml` workflow triggered on `pull_request`. Dramatically improves review quality for UI and auth changes.

initiatives.title: Automated CHANGELOG generation from conventional commits
initiatives.description: Add `standard-version` or `release-please` GitHub Action that auto-generates CHANGELOG.md entries from conventional commit messages on each merge to master. The action bumps `src/version.ts` patch/minor/major based on commit type (fix/feat/BREAKING CHANGE), creates a git tag, and updates CHANGELOG.md in the same commit. Currently CHANGELOG.md exists but is updated manually. Removes release maintenance burden from engineers.

initiatives.title: Firebase App Distribution for internal beta builds
initiatives.description: Add a `beta-distribute.yml` GitHub Actions workflow that builds the Capacitor iOS and Android apps on each merge to `staging` branch and distributes to a Firebase App Distribution tester group. QA team members receive an install link within minutes of a staging merge. Currently beta testing requires manual Xcode/Android Studio builds. Cuts internal QA cycle time from hours to minutes.

initiatives.title: External uptime monitoring with 5-minute probe interval
initiatives.description: Configure an external uptime monitor (Freshping free tier or UptimeRobot) that probes `anchor-os.web.app` every 5 minutes and sends a Slack/email alert within 10 minutes of downtime. Also probe `us-central1-anchor-os-production.cloudfunctions.net/getNotifications` for function availability. Currently there is no external probe — downtime is only detected by user reports. A 30-minute outage can go unnoticed. First item in an SRE practice.

initiatives.title: Firebase Firestore quota monitoring and alert at 80% threshold
initiatives.description: Firebase Free and Blaze plans have daily Firestore quotas. Set up Google Cloud Monitoring budget alerts + a daily Cloud Function that reads Firestore usage metrics from the Firebase Management API and writes to a `quotaHealth` document. Alert fires (email + Slack) when daily reads/writes reach 80% of the configured daily limit. Without this, production can hit quota limits silently and fail for all users until midnight UTC reset.

initiatives.title: Cloud Function cold start profiling and keep-warm strategy
initiatives.description: Cloud Functions (Node.js Gen2) cold start times impact first-open UX. Profile current cold start p95 for the 5 highest-traffic callables (getNotifications, createFamilyInvitation, logAuditEvent, processReminders, generateWeeklyReport). For callables that must be fast (<500ms), configure minimum instances in firebase.json. For scheduled functions, a pre-warm HTTP ping in the merge-gate pre-deploy step. Target: p95 cold start < 2s for all user-facing callables.

initiatives.title: Custom illustration library for empty states, onboarding, and error pages
initiatives.description: Replace generic placeholder empty states (no transactions yet, no commitments, no family connected) with bespoke Anchor OS illustrations — calm, abstract, African-design-influenced visual language. SVG-based, dark mode aware, colour-token-compliant. Illustrate: (1) Empty finance view, (2) Empty commitments, (3) Empty Fabric (no insights yet), (4) Onboarding Welcome, (5) Family not connected, (6) 404 and 500 error pages. A distinct visual identity that sets Anchor apart from generic fintech apps.

initiatives.title: Micro-interaction motion system — transaction save, commitment complete, account create
initiatives.description: Define and implement a set of purposeful micro-animations in a `src/animations/` module: (1) Transaction saved → brief green checkmark bloom on the form, (2) Commitment completed → gentle strike-through + fade, (3) Account created → card slides in from bottom with a soft spring, (4) Net worth increase → subtle upward particle burst (non-gamified, purely ambient). Built with CSS `@keyframes` in the design token system — respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. Makes interactions feel alive without being distracting.

initiatives.title: Compact density mode — comfortable vs compact information layout
initiatives.description: Add a 'Display density' setting (Settings → Appearance): 'Comfortable' (current default — more whitespace, larger touch targets) vs 'Compact' (tighter rows, smaller text, 20% more items visible). Compact mode uses Tailwind `data-density=compact` attribute on root element with overrides for padding, line height, and row height. Particularly valuable for power users who want to see 3 months of transactions without scrolling. Mobile-safe: minimum 44px touch targets maintained in both modes.

initiatives.title: A/B testing infrastructure — experiment variants in analytics events
initiatives.description: Add an experiment assignment system: `getExperimentVariant(experimentId)` reads from Firebase Remote Config (ARCH-021) and returns 'control' or 'treatment'. Variant is attached to every analytics event as `experimentId` + `variant` fields. Enables product experiments: does PRD-007 (goal-setting onboarding) improve 30-day retention? Are users who see INN-004 (goal projection) more likely to stay 60 days? No external tool needed — built on existing Remote Config + analytics event contract.

initiatives.title: Fabric insight effectiveness measurement — did users act on insights?
initiatives.description: When a Fabric insight or prediction card is shown, log a `fabric_insight_shown` event. If the user takes a relevant action within 24 hours (creates a transaction in the flagged category, adjusts a recurring, completes a commitment), log `fabric_insight_acted`. Track the conversion rate per insight category (commitments, spending, predictions) via aggregation in Firestore. Enables Fabric team to measure which insight types actually change behaviour and which are ignored. Essential for FAB-001 (LLM) ROI measurement.

initiatives.title: User retention cohort analysis — weekly survival curves by signup cohort
initiatives.description: A weekly scheduled Cloud Function aggregates anonymised retention data: for users who signed up in week W, how many were active (≥1 transaction or ≥1 task) in weeks W+1, W+2, W+4, W+8, W+12? Results stored in `analytics/retention/cohorts/{week}`. Dashboard in the PM tools shows survival curves per cohort. Helps identify where users drop off (after onboarding? after first month?) and validates whether new features are improving retention. No PII — cohort IDs only.

initiatives.title: Firestore composite index catalog — documented, versioned, enforced in CI
initiatives.description: Create `docs/FIRESTORE_INDEXES.md` documenting all required composite indexes, their justification, and the queries they serve. Add a CI check that validates `config/firestore.indexes.json` matches the documented catalog. Include a test scenario in the Firestore emulator that executes every documented composite query to verify the index exists. Currently `firestore.indexes.json` exists but is undocumented and not validated. Index drift causes silent production failures when indexes are created manually and not committed.

initiatives.title: Per-session Firestore read cost monitoring — outlier detection and alerting
initiatives.description: Instrument the `secureDb.ts` wrapper to count reads per session in-memory. On app close (visibilitychange to hidden), write a telemetry event with `sessionReadCount`, `sessionDuration`, `tabView` to a `diagnostics` collection. A daily Cloud Function aggregates p95 read counts per user and alerts if any user exceeds 5,000 reads/session (Firebase free tier: 50,000 reads/day). This identifies high-read code paths (e.g., a Firestore `onSnapshot` listener that re-triggers on every keystroke) before they appear on the billing dashboard.

initiatives.title: Automated cold-tier archival of transactions older than 2 years
initiatives.description: Implement a monthly Cloud Function that moves transactions older than 2 years from the hot Firestore tier to a Cloud Storage JSON archive file (`gs://anchor-os-archive/users/{uid}/transactions/{year}.json`). Soft-delete record in Firestore to maintain referential integrity. Archive files are encrypted with Cloud KMS. Reduces Firestore document count, cutting storage costs as the user base grows. Users can request archive download via Settings → Data Management.

initiatives.title: Sign in with Apple — required for iOS App Store social auth compliance
initiatives.description: Apple App Store guidelines require apps offering third-party social sign-in (AUTH-001 covers Google) to also offer Sign in with Apple. Implement using Firebase Auth `OAuthProvider('apple.com')` + Capacitor `@capacitor-community/apple-sign-in` for native modal on iOS. Web fallback uses Firebase redirect flow. On Android, Sign in with Apple still works via web flow. Critical blocking item for App Store submission once AUTH-001 (Social Sign-In) is shipped.

initiatives.title: Email address change flow with re-verification and Firestore sync
initiatives.description: Currently there is no UI to change email address. Flow: (1) User enters new email in Settings → Security, (2) Password re-auth required, (3) Firebase `updateEmail()` + `sendEmailVerification()` to new address, (4) Firestore `profiles/{uid}.email` updated atomically, (5) Family connection emails updated if relevant, (6) Pending invitations with old email invalidated. Must handle the race condition where the auth email and Firestore email diverge if step (4) fails. Needs a Firestore trigger to keep emails in sync.

initiatives.title: Guest / anonymous mode — explore Anchor without signing up, then convert
initiatives.description: Allow unauthenticated users to explore the full app with pre-seeded demo data using Firebase Anonymous Auth. A persistent 'Save your progress — Create an account' banner shows throughout. On account creation, link the anonymous session to the new account (Firebase `linkWithCredential()`) and migrate the demo data to the new user's Firestore documents. Demo data is read from a static `demoData.ts` fixture — no Firestore reads for guests. Lowers signup barrier dramatically for app store acquisition.

initiatives.title: Auth event security alerts — notify user of unrecognised sign-ins via email
initiatives.description: When a sign-in event is detected from a new device (different user-agent hash) or an unusual time (not seen before in last 30 days), send an automated email: 'A new sign-in to your Anchor account was detected from iPhone 15 Pro on Safari at 2:14 AM.' User can tap 'This wasn't me → Revoke access.' Email delivered via existing `sendTemplatedEmail` callable. Pairs with SEC-009 (auth event history). Provides proactive security alerting without requiring MFA.

initiatives.title: ESLint module boundary rules — enforce no cross-feature direct imports
initiatives.description: Add `eslint-plugin-import` rules that prevent `src/features/finance/` from directly importing `src/features/commitments/` or `src/features/fabric/`. All cross-feature communication must go through `src/hooks/`, `src/context/`, or `src/services/`. Add a custom rule that fails if any `features/X` file imports from `features/Y` (where X ≠ Y) without an intermediate service/hook. Currently the codebase is clean but without enforcement any PR could break module isolation. ADR documenting the boundary decision.

initiatives.title: Versioned Cloud Function callable APIs — v1/v2 naming with backward compatibility
initiatives.description: Introduce callable function versioning: `createFamilyInvitation_v2` runs alongside `createFamilyInvitation_v1` during migration windows. Client-side `callableApi.ts` resolves the correct version based on the deployed app version. Enables gradual rollout of breaking callable changes without requiring all clients to be on the latest version simultaneously. Critical for Capacitor native apps where app store review delays mean old versions remain live for weeks.

initiatives.title: Firestore rules test coverage enforcement — gate on uncovered rule paths
initiatives.description: The Firestore rules emulator test suite (44 tests) is comprehensive but not coverage-enforced. Add a `@firebase/rules-unit-testing` coverage reporter that outputs which rule paths were exercised and which were not. Fail CI if any `allow read/write` rule has 0 test coverage. Requires parsing the coverage output from the Firebase emulator's coverage endpoint (`localhost:8080/emulator/v1/projects/{projectId}:ruleCoverage`). Prevents new rules from shipping without tests.

initiatives.title: Automated dead code detection — unused exports scanning in CI
initiatives.description: Add `ts-prune` or `knip` to the merge-gate CI pipeline to detect unused exported functions, types, and components. Report as warnings (not failures) initially; create a dedicated tracking issue for existing dead code. After the first clean sweep, promote to a hard failure gate. Prevents the codebase from accumulating stale exports as features are refactored. Currently files are ≤200 lines (ARCH-001) but there is no protection against unused exports that silently bloat the bundle.

initiatives.title: Engineering RFC process — lightweight ADR for every significant technical decision
initiatives.description: Establish a lightweight Request for Comments (RFC) process: any change to system architecture, data model, auth flow, or external service integration requires a `docs/adr/ADR-NNN-title.md` file before implementation begins. ADR template: Context → Decision → Alternatives Considered → Consequences → Owner → Date. Two existing ADRs in `docs/adr/` — make this a process with a policy gate: PRs that bypass the ADR requirement for architecture-level changes are blocked by a checklist review. Creates institutional memory and prevents future 'why did we do it this way?' questions.

initiatives.title: Technical debt burndown register with quarterly scheduling
initiatives.description: Create `docs/TECH_DEBT.md` as a living register of all known technical debt: entry format includes debt description, affected files, estimated effort, business risk of not fixing, and owning team. Every quarter, the principal engineering team reviews the register and schedules 20% of sprint capacity toward debt items. Currently tech debt is tracked ad hoc in roadmap items (GAP-* prefix). Formalising the register gives it visibility, prevents surprise rewrites, and makes the cost of debt explicit.

initiatives.title: Per-route performance budgets — LCP and CLS targets enforced per screen
initiatives.description: Define explicit performance budgets per route in `lighthouserc.cjs`: Dashboard route LCP < 1.8s, Finance route (with transaction list) LCP < 2.5s, Auth route LCP < 1.2s. Fabric route FID < 100ms. Merge-gate Lighthouse CI enforces these per-route targets, not just overall scores. Forces engineers to measure the performance impact of every new widget, hook, or service on the routes that host them. Makes performance regressions route-attributable, not just app-wide averages.

initiatives.title: Smart transaction quick-entry — natural language amount + title parsing
initiatives.description: A floating '+' button on the Finance tab opens a single-line quick-entry field. User types 'coffee 500' or 'salary 250000 income' or 'rent 150k expense'. A lightweight client-side parser (`parseQuickEntry()`) extracts: amount (handles 'k' suffix → *1000), title, and type hint ('income'/'expense'). The parsed values pre-fill the full TransactionForm which opens below. Reduces the most common interaction (manual expense entry) from 6 taps to 2. 75% of users are mobile — low-friction entry is the #1 retention driver for a manual ledger.

initiatives.title: Daily financial journal note — one optional note per day attached to the day's summary
initiatives.description: At the bottom of each day's transaction group in AccountDetailsView, a '+ Add a note for today' field lets users write a one-sentence financial journal entry (max 140 chars): 'Had to deal with a car repair this week', 'Great restraint at the mall today!'. Stored in `accounts/{id}/dayNotes/{YYYY-MM-DD}`. Notes visible only to the account owner. Fabric can optionally surface patterns from notes. Transforms Anchor from a number tracker into a personal finance journal — a differentiator no mainstream fintech has.

initiatives.title: Net worth milestone momentss — calm, non-gamified recognition of financial progress
initiatives.description: When a user's total net worth crosses a round milestone (₦100k, ₦500k, ₦1M, etc.) for the first time, Anchor shows a calm, non-intrusive notification: a subtle shimmer on the Portfolio Widget and a soft toast: 'You've crossed ₦1,000,000 in net worth. Well done.' No confetti, no badges, no scoreboards — just a moment of acknowledgement. Data driven by the existing NetWorth calculation in DashboardView. First milestone crossed: triggered via `previousNetWorth < milestone <= newNetWorth` comparison on each dashboard refresh.

initiatives.title: Commitment notes and context field — add a why and a description
initiatives.description: Add an optional `notes` field (max 200 chars) to the AnchorTask model. In TaskForm, a collapsible 'Add context' section lets users write the why: 'I do this to stay grounded before work' or 'Saves ₦3,000 per month'. Notes shown as secondary text on TaskItem. Fabric can reference the `notes` field when generating the Daily Briefing to personalise suggestions. Currently task records only have a `title`. The 'why' behind a commitment is proven to dramatically improve follow-through.

initiatives.title: Commitment priority levels — mark which commitments matter most today
initiatives.description: Add an optional `priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'` field to AnchorTask. In TaskList, 'high' priority items always show first regardless of type. A priority indicator (solid dot, coloured dot, outline dot) appears on TaskItem. Today's Focus Widget on the Dashboard shows high-priority items first. Allows users to distinguish between 'must do today' and 'nice to do' without converting everything to type: 'daily'. Keeps the commitment system flexible without adding a full project management UI.

initiatives.title: Financial calendar view — month grid showing planned income and expenses
initiatives.description: A 'Calendar' tab or toggle in FinanceView renders a monthly grid calendar. Each day shows: coloured dots for transactions (green=income, red=expense). Tap a day → day detail drawer. Future dates show RecurringTransaction expected dates as ghost markers. This gives users the temporal context missing from the list view — 'when are my big expenses hitting vs when is my paycheck?' Implemented client-side using existing transaction data. No new data model needed. CalendarView component + useCalendarEvents() hook.

initiatives.title: Recurring transactions automation
initiatives.description: Automatically create transaction records at defined intervals (weekly/monthly). Users configure recurrence on any transaction; a Cloud Function writes new records on schedule. Eliminates manual re-entry for fixed expenses like rent and subscriptions.

initiatives.title: Split transactions across categories
initiatives.description: Allow a single transaction to be split into multiple sub-line items with independent category assignments and amounts that sum to the parent total. Addresses grocery trips that span food, household, and health categories.

initiatives.title: Bill payment reminders with calendar integration
initiatives.description: Users tag transactions or manual entries as recurring bills with due dates. Push notifications fire 3 days and 1 day before due. Calendar view shows upcoming obligations. Reduces missed payments and overdraft risk.

initiatives.title: Net worth history chart and sparkline
initiatives.description: Store a weekly net worth snapshot in a netWorthHistory subcollection via the weekly report Cloud Function. Render a sparkline on the dashboard and a full chart on the finance page. Makes financial progress visible over time.

initiatives.title: Cursor-based Firestore pagination for transactions
initiatives.description: Replace the current limit-only query in useTransactionSearch with cursor-based pagination using Firestore startAfter(). Load 50 transactions per page with a 'load more' trigger. Current approach fails gracefully only up to ~1000 transactions.

initiatives.title: Commitment streak tracking with gentle nudges
initiatives.description: Track consecutive days/weeks a commitment is honored. Display streak count on commitment cards. Send a non-intrusive nudge push notification if a streak is at risk (24 hrs before the daily deadline). No gamification badges — just a counter and a calm reminder.

initiatives.title: Commitment calendar view (month and week)
initiatives.description: Add a calendar view to the commitments tab showing completion status by day. Month view shows heat-map density; week view shows individual completion per commitment. Tap a day to see detail. Helps users see patterns at a glance.

initiatives.title: Commitment templates library
initiatives.description: Offer a curated set of starter commitment templates (e.g., 'Save ₦X per week', 'Review budget every Sunday') so new users can quickly add meaningful commitments. Templates are non-editable starting points, not locked contracts.

initiatives.title: Bulk commitment actions (complete and archive multiple)
initiatives.description: Long-press to enter multi-select mode on the commitments list. Allow bulk complete, bulk archive, or bulk delete with a single tap. Reduces friction for users with many commitments to manage end-of-week.

initiatives.title: Commitment sharing and family accountability
initiatives.description: Let users optionally share a commitment with their family partner. The partner sees commitment status on their dashboard and can send an encouragement react. No scores or pressure — just shared visibility.

initiatives.title: Multi-member household support (3+ members)
initiatives.description: Extend the current 1:1 family pairing model to support households with up to 6 members. Introduce a household document with a members array and role assignments (owner, manager, viewer). All shared finance queries must scope to householdId.

initiatives.title: Shared family budget pools with individual limits
initiatives.description: Allow a household to define a shared budget pool for categories like groceries or utilities, with per-member spending tracked against that pool. Dashboard shows pool utilisation per category. Requires FAM-001 (multi-member households).

initiatives.title: Family activity feed with real-time transaction notifications
initiatives.description: Show a chronological feed of family member financial activity (new transactions, budget changes, account additions). Real-time via Firestore onSnapshot. Members can mute categories. Keeps everyone informed without feeling surveilled.

initiatives.title: Household aggregate net worth calculation
initiatives.description: Sum account balances across all household members into a single household net worth figure. Display on family dashboard. Requires read access to member accounts per role. Basis for FAM-002 shared budget pools.

initiatives.title: LLM / Genkit integration for Anchor AI Fabric
initiatives.description: Replace the current rule-based Fabric engine with an LLM call (Google Genkit / Vertex AI) that receives summarised financial context (no raw PII). The Cloud Function fabricChat constructs a structured prompt from aggregated stats and returns insights, suggestions, and natural-language answers. Raw transaction data never leaves Firestore.

initiatives.title: Fabric insight explainability — show reasoning
initiatives.description: For every Fabric suggestion or prediction, surface a one-sentence explanation of why it was generated (e.g., 'You spent 40% more on food this month vs last month'). Makes AI output trustworthy and non-magical. Pairs with FAB-001.

initiatives.title: Spending anomaly detection alerts
initiatives.description: Fabric Behavioral engine detects when category spending exceeds 2x the 3-month rolling average and fires a push notification. Uses existing rule-based engine; no LLM required. Immediate user value from current Fabric architecture.

initiatives.title: Personalised savings suggestions from Fabric
initiatives.description: Based on income vs spend patterns, Fabric Insights engine identifies the largest reducible category and proposes a specific savings amount per month. Surfaces as a card on the dashboard. Calculated server-side in the weekly report function.

initiatives.title: Mono webhook HMAC-SHA512 signature verification
initiatives.description: The bankWebhook Cloud Function currently accepts all incoming Mono events without verifying the mono-webhook-secret HMAC-SHA512 header. An attacker can spoof balance updates or inject fraudulent transactions. Add signature verification before any event processing.

initiatives.title: Client-side rate limiting for auth forms
initiatives.description: Add exponential back-off and lockout UI on the sign-in and sign-up forms after 5 consecutive failures without relying solely on Firebase Auth server-side throttling. Prevents rapid-fire credential stuffing from being user-invisible.

initiatives.title: Field-level encryption for sensitive Firestore data
initiatives.description: Encrypt account numbers, balances, and transaction amounts at the application layer before writing to Firestore. Use a per-user key derived from Firebase Auth UID + a server-side KMS secret. Firestore at-rest encryption is insufficient alone — field encryption prevents Google employees and DB breaches from reading raw financial data.

initiatives.title: Android Play Integrity / iOS DeviceCheck app attestation
initiatives.description: Integrate Play Integrity API (Android) and DeviceCheck (iOS) via Capacitor plugins to verify the app is running on a trusted, unmodified device. Pass attestation token to Cloud Functions for high-risk operations (account linking, large transfers).

initiatives.title: Sensitive data masking in Sentry error reports
initiatives.description: Configure Sentry beforeSend hook to scrub account numbers, transaction amounts, and Firestore document IDs from error payloads before they leave the device. Currently, an unhandled exception in finance views could leak PII to Sentry.

initiatives.title: Session idle lock with biometric re-auth
initiatives.description: After 15 minutes of inactivity, lock the app with a PIN or biometric prompt (extending PWA-005). Uses Capacitor App.addListener('appStateChange') and an inactivity timer. Prevents unauthorised access when a device is left unlocked. Distinct from session management UI (AUTH-003).

initiatives.title: Android hardware back-gesture navigation
initiatives.description: Handle the Android back gesture and hardware back button via @capacitor/app App.addListener('backButton'). Current behaviour exits the app or navigates incorrectly on nested modal screens. Build a navigation stack aware handler integrated with React Router.

initiatives.title: iOS haptic feedback on key financial interactions
initiatives.description: Trigger light/medium haptic feedback on transaction creation, commitment completion, and destructive confirmations using @capacitor/haptics. Adds native feel on iOS without any visual change. Android uses platform vibration via the same API.

initiatives.title: Push notification deep links with action routing
initiatives.description: Tapping a push notification (bill reminder, commitment nudge, anomaly alert) should open the relevant screen directly rather than the app home. Use FCM data payload with 'route' field and Capacitor PushNotifications.addListener('pushNotificationActionPerformed') to route on open.

initiatives.title: IndexedDB-backed persistent offline queue
initiatives.description: The current offline mutation queue is held in memory — closing the tab or crashing the app loses queued writes. Replace with an IndexedDB-backed queue (via idb-keyval or Dexie) so operations survive app restarts and are replayed on next connection. Supersedes PWA-003 which only addresses the indicator UI.

initiatives.title: Remote Config integration for dynamic feature flags
initiatives.description: The current feature flag system (src/utils/featureFlags.ts) is static — flags are baked at build time. Integrate Firebase Remote Config so flags can be toggled without a deploy. Critical for safe rollouts of FAM-001 and FAB-001.

initiatives.title: Financial mutation audit log with event sourcing
initiatives.description: Write an immutable audit record to a /ledger subcollection on every create/update/delete of transactions and accounts. Each record includes userId, timestamp, operationType, before/after snapshot, and IP hash. Basis for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance.

initiatives.title: Background job queue for recurring tasks (Cloud Tasks)
initiatives.description: Replace direct Cloud Scheduler cron calls with a Cloud Tasks queue for recurring transaction creation, weekly reports, and bill reminders. Enables retries, rate limiting, fan-out per user, and avoids the current single-cron bottleneck for large user bases.

initiatives.title: Virtual scrolling for large transaction lists
initiatives.description: Implement window virtualisation (react-virtual or @tanstack/virtual) on TransactionList so only visible rows are in the DOM. Current DOM-based rendering degradates at 200+ transactions. Prerequisite complementary to FIN-016 (cursor pagination).

initiatives.title: Lazy-load heavy dependencies by route
initiatives.description: Split Sentry initialisation, analytics, and Fabric view into dynamic import() chunks. Only import when the relevant route is visited. Reduces cold-start bundle size and TTI on the auth and dashboard entry paths. Measurable via Lighthouse CI.

initiatives.title: Real-time error rate alerting and SLO dashboard
initiatives.description: Configure Sentry alert rules to fire a Slack/email notification when the error rate exceeds 1% of sessions in a 10-minute window. Define SLOs: 99.5% availability, p95 transaction < 2s. Dashboard shows SLO burn rate. Currently there is no automated paging for production incidents.

initiatives.title: Performance budget enforcement in CI
initiatives.description: Add a Lighthouse CI step to merge-gate.yml that fails the build if LCP > 2.5s, TBT > 300ms, or bundle size increases by more than 10 KB. Prevents performance regressions from shipping silently. Uses existing lighthouserc.cjs config.

initiatives.title: User journey analytics funnels
initiatives.description: Instrument onboarding, account linking, and first transaction creation flows as conversion funnels in Firebase Analytics. Identify where users drop off. Data informs product roadmap prioritisation and is privacy-safe (no PII in events).

initiatives.title: Storybook component playground and visual catalog
initiatives.description: Set up Storybook 8 with Vite. Add stories for Button, TransactionItem, AccountCard, CategoryIcon, and all form fields. Enables isolated component development and acts as a living design system reference. Pairs with DES-001 (component library extraction).

initiatives.title: API mock layer for offline dev and E2E tests
initiatives.description: Build a MSW (Mock Service Worker) layer that intercepts Firebase calls in local dev and E2E (Playwright). Enables fully offline development without Firebase emulators, faster CI, and deterministic test data. Reduces flake in E2E suite.

initiatives.title: Automated accessibility testing in CI
initiatives.description: Add axe-core / @axe-core/playwright assertions to the smoke E2E spec and a standalone a11y test suite. Fails CI on WCAG 2.1 AA violations. Pairs with UX-032 (accessibility controls) to ensure future changes don't regress keyboard/screen reader support.

initiatives.title: Spending trends and insights deep-dive page
initiatives.description: A dedicated page (or dashboard section) with month-over-month bar charts, category breakdowns, and top-5 merchant lists. Uses existing transaction data; charts rendered with chart.js or Recharts. Fabric FAB-004 savings suggestions surface here.

initiatives.title: PDF / printable financial report export
initiatives.description: Generate a monthly financial summary PDF client-side using jsPDF or react-pdf. Includes net worth, income vs expenses, top categories, and commitment completion rate. Users can download or share. Complements existing CSV/JSON export (FIN-004).
